prerequisites: Building mathematical reasoning and proving theorems
Participation certificate for a standard test (ijkingstoets)

learning_outcomes.text: Students must be able to translate a given problem statement into a design using principles such as modularization, cohesion, and responsibility-based design.
Students must understand and be able to use the basic principles of programming.
Students must be able to prove the correctness of an algorithm, as well as derive its time complexity.
Students must have a basic understanding of how a computer executes programs, and what influence this can have on the correct functioning of developed programs.

syllabus_topics: Introduction: Algorithms and programs; problem analysis, software design and implementation; the complexity problem. Programs as models of a problem domain. Computer architecture.
Control structures: selection statements, while loops, for loops.
Collections: fixed and variable size collections, iterators.
Inheritance: Single inheritance, method redefinition, polymorphism and dynamic binding, abstract classes & interfaces.
Reasoning about programs: Deliberate construction of programs using invariants, correctness proofs, algorithm complexity.
Recursion: Recursion using simple examples: factorial function, greatest common divisor, Towers of Hanoi. Divide and conquer strategy for problem-solving.
teaching_methods: Practical exercises in a PC-class with assistant supervision

assessment_methods.method: Written examination during the examination period

assessment_rules: The final written exam is an open-book computer exam where only the course text and some pre-specified documents are allowed. The text may be colored and small notes may be added, but it may not be supplemented with exercise solutions or extra examples. If the evaluation shows that the student has insufficiently achieved one or more objectives of the course, the overall result may deviate from the weighted average of the components. Students whose native language is not Dutch may use one non-technical translating dictionary during evaluations, provided they register with the ombudsman by specific deadlines.
